svg.text: ARC-001: End-to-End System Topology & Service Architecture
Multi-Tier Microservices: Edge BFF Gateway -> Swarm Orchestrator -> Veritas 5-Axis Engine -> Model Router -> Enterprise Persistence

g.text: • Multi-Model Consensus Evaluators: Gemini 2.5 Pro + Claude 3.5 Sonnet
• Hard Gate: Safety & Policy score must be exactly 100/100
• Cryptographic Provenance: Ed25519 Signed Verification Certificate (VQC)
• Priority Queue Partitioning: P0 Live Stream > P1 Background Jobs
• Concurrency Rate Limiter & Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) Auto-Retry
S3 / GCS Cloud Storage (C2PA Signed Media)
• Master MP4 Storyboards, 5-Band WAV Stems, Draw.io XML SVGs
• Immutable Version Control with CDN Edge Distribution
